description: A concision step and a synced wordy-phrase list for /ste

userStories.title: Concision step in rewrite mode
userStories.description: As a writer, I want rewrite mode to name the concision step. I then cut restated text without a merge of steps or a loss of meaning.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/ste/SKILL.md` § Rewrite mode has a step after the step that splits a step with more than one action, and before the placeholder step. The step says: delete each sentence, clause, or table row that restates a fact stated elsewhere in the document, unless the text adds a condition, an actor, a value, or a warning.
The same step says: never merge steps, and never drop a precedence or an order, to cut length.
The section intro names the new step count, and the steps stay numbered in sequence.
userStories.notes: Executed on the task branch: SKILL.md § Rewrite mode reads nine steps; new step 7 sits after the split step (6) and before the placeholder step (8), with the required delete-restatement wording, the never-merge/never-drop-precedence sentence, and the rule 53 reference; steps run 1 to 9. ste-check.sh SKILL.md exit 0; --blocks after exit 0; --blocks before exit 1 (90 findings). The only other step reference (step 2 of rewrite mode) did not move.

userStories.title: Wordy phrases in the WORD detector
userStories.description: As a writer, I want the checker to flag each wordy phrase that the dictionary lists. The checker then enforces the dictionary instead of a subset of it.
acceptanceCriteria: The `WORD` list in `.agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh` holds each phrase of `references/dictionary.md` § Wordy phrases, and the phrases `note that`, `make sure`, `be sure to`, and `keep in mind` of § Marketing and filler.
A phrase that matches text inside a word of an `after` specimen is left out, and the report names the phrase.
userStories.notes: Executed on the task branch: the WORD list adds the dictionary wordy phrases and note that, make sure, be sure to, keep in mind; as far as X is concerned is matched by its own pattern. --blocks after exits 0; --blocks before exits 1 with 94 findings (was 90); ste-check on SKILL.md and rules.md reports no finding; shellcheck exit 0.

userStories.title: Manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the operator, I want a record of the checker on real text. I can then see the new findings before the change lands.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/ste-concision-step/evidence/manual-review.md` records both fixture commands with their exit codes and finding counts.
The evidence records the finding count of the new phrases on each `SKILL.md` and each `docs/*.md` file of the harness, before and after the change, and quotes up to 10 new findings.
The evidence marks each quoted finding as a true or a false positive.
The story changes no document outside `.agro/skills/ste/` to fix a new finding.
userStories.notes: Recorded by the worker and re-run: --blocks after exit 0 with 0 findings; --blocks before exit 1 with 94 (old checker 90; the 4 new are WORD make sure and note that in before specimens). 25 SKILL.md and 12 docs files: 102 findings before, 103 after; the only new finding is WORD note that at .agro/skills/langfuse/SKILL.md:131, a true positive; no false positive. No document outside .agro/skills/ste/ changed. Advisor: ste-check on the evidence exit 0; the commit adds only the evidence file.
